import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuShortcut,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export function DropdownMenuShortcuts() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Open</DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuLabel>My Account</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Profile
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+P" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Billing
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+B" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Settings
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+S" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          Log out
          <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+Q" />
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
